Method of Attack: Ransomware attack encrypting data and demanding ransom
Impacted Systems: Costa Rican Social Security Fund (CCCS/CCSS) computer systems
Attack Vector: Network intrusion leading to ransomware deployment
Use of initial attack accesses provided by Conti
Ransomware-as-a-Service model with affiliates and partners
Indicators of Compromise: Stacks of printed pages with gibberish ASCII-based text
Leak blogs of Hive and Conti showing victims' data
Public statements on Twitter by CCCS
